seed: Every gap in a column is the gap the column was given, even where a piece changes size on its way into it. Two pictures: the starter Card, whose title used to sit a point closer to the line under it than to the picture above it, and a stack inside a stack, stretched across a column 300 wide, whose words re-wrap and make it taller than it was going in. The piece under that one used to be placed for the shorter box, so the column wrote one thing through another.

steps.note: the starter Card: picture well, title, supporting line, one gap of 8 between all three

a box, the inner stack and another box in a column 300 wide

THE TEST: everything in the column stretched across it. The inner stack is narrowed to 300, its words re-wrap, and it comes out taller than it went in. The box under it must still sit the column's gap below it, not through it.

THE OTHER TEST: the column's right edge dragged in, photographed with the button still down. A live drag lays the column out once, so this is where a piece that changes size on its way in shows: the box under the inner stack used to be placed for the height that stack had BEFORE its words re-wrapped, and was drawn through it.
